name: ScopeKeeper
description: Manage Microsoft DHCP servers: scopes, options, reservations, failover and a full configuration check.
long_description: Alpha – not yet tested against real DHCP servers. Connects to a Microsoft DHCP server (IPv4) with the current account, stored credentials or a different login and keeps the failover partners in view. Every scope opens in its own tab with general settings, address ranges, options, reservations, exclusions, leases and failover state; findings (errors, warnings, best practice) are calculated while you type and mark the affected fields. New scopes are created from a draft or duplicated from an existing scope, with addresses converted to the new network. Changes on failover scopes can be replicated to the partner automatically (works even when the partner is only reachable via RPC, like the DHCP console). Further pages: server options, failover relationships with comparison and raw view, option definitions and a server-wide scan. Requires the RSAT DHCP tools (added automatically during installation).
author: DarkMatter
